_comment: 3.0, notifications: a mako config the user (or zeta-accent, which rewrites border-color) changed is not replaced by update-3.0-0-defaults; it still gets the longer history for zeta-dnd history and critical notifications that show during Do Not Disturb. The 3.0 file does not contain the old text, so it is never patched twice.

steps.old:
icon-path=/usr/share/icons/zeta

# Do Not Disturb (from the Control Center)
[mode=do-not-disturb]
invisible=1
steps.new:
icon-path=/usr/share/icons/zeta
# recent notifications for "zeta-dnd history" (mako keeps 5 by default)
max-history=50

# Do Not Disturb (zeta-dnd, from the Control Center or Settings)
[mode=do-not-disturb]
invisible=1

# critical notifications (battery almost empty...) still appear
[mode=do-not-disturb urgency=critical]
invisible=0
